customer: Minivan lease ends soon, it's my business vehicle. Should I sell it to you or just turn it in?
agent: Per our article "Selling vs. turning in at lease end," turning it in is simpler, but you may pay for extra miles or wear. Selling can make sense when the van is worth more than your lease buyout amount, meaning our offer comes in higher than the buyout. We'd suggest getting an offer from us before your turn-in date and comparing it with your buyout quote.
